quotes.text: QSF16. Relazione di parentela RICODIFICATA NELLA VARIABILE RUOLOFAM
RUOLOFAM Ruolo in famiglia  Unipersonale 1  Genitore in coppia 2  Monogenitore 3  Coniuge senza figli 4  Figlio 5  Figlio di monogenitore 6  Altro 7

assessments.reasoning: The supplied questionnaire does not identify or designate a household head (capofamiglia). Relationships among household members are collected in QSF16 and recoded into RUOLOFAM (family role), which classifies individual positions within family units (e.g. parent in couple, single parent, child) without establishing a household head. Because no method for identifying a household head is provided or defined in the instrument, none of the categorical options apply.
